newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close up on APEC, GNP factors.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close up on APEC, GNP factors.

text.p: The Philippine share index closed up on Monday by 32.76 points, or 1.07 percent, at 3,105.55 points on the forthcoming APEC summit and release of gross national product (GNP) data, traders said.
"Most blue chips except PLDT improved today as investors are looking at the APEC as an add-on attraction," said Harry Liu, president of Summit Securities.
The all-share index rose by 5.82 points to 1,010.63 at close.
Liu said the APEC summit bouys up sentiment and assures investors of a positive investment environment in the Philippines.

"There's accumulation on blue chips and its likely because of the positive sentiment generated by APEC and the GNP data to be released next week," said Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities & Securities Corp.
But value of shares traded was thin at 2.3 billion pesos. Decliners were almost the same as advancers at 59 to 58 with 66 unchanged issues.
Traders said the market will move sideways this week with an upward bias. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937 Fax 8176267
